title: Honeyed Ukrainian Butter Bake
description: A unique twist on traditional Ukrainian dishes, this recipe combines crispy buttery layers with a touch of honey for a sweet and savory brunch treat.

ingredients.name: 2 cups all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use unbleached, unbromated flour for best results

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
1/4 cup honey
ingredients.notes: use pure Grade A honey for best flavor

ingredients.name: 2 large eggs
ingredients.notes: use room temperature eggs for best results

ingredients.name: 1 cup heavy cream
ingredients.notes: chilled heavy cream is essential for best whipped topping results

instructions: Using a stand mixer with a paddle attachment, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
With mixer on low speed, gradually add flour, mixing until just combined.
Pour batter into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Place baking dish in a larger pan or roasting pan and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
While cake is cooling, whip heavy cream in a separate bowl until stiff peaks form.
Spread whipped cream over the top of the cake, then drizzle with melted butter and honey.
Serve warm, garnished with additional honey and chopped nuts if desired.
Note: baking time may vary depending on oven type and temperature, so keep an eye on the cake and adjust baking time as needed.
